scenarios.injection: approved knowledge readiness probe returns unavailable

scenarios.expected: API returns 504 and persists a sanitized failed observation

scenarios.injection: tool handler returns an object that violates its output schema
scenarios.expected: registry returns a structured VALIDATION_ERROR envelope

scenarios.injection: same user, idempotency key, and payload submitted twice
scenarios.expected: second request replays the first result without another agent run

scenarios.injection: knowledge query has no matching terms
scenarios.expected: tool returns successful structured output with returned_count zero

scenarios.injection: investigator raises AgentLimitError at its round boundary
scenarios.expected: API returns a bounded 503 and records the limit failure

scenarios.injection: one user exceeds the investigation sliding-window limit
scenarios.expected: API returns 429 with Retry-After and performs no extra agent run

scope_note: The accepted product runtime uses lexical retrieval. The unavailable retrieval test therefore breaks the approved knowledge dependency rather than pretending the unused Commit 06 vector store is on the serving path.
